_comment: Dedicated fixture for defeat_ally_alive. Identical to post_tutorial (warrior L1, met_relc, floodplains 7,6) EXCEPT rng_state, tuned so the level_up_loop-style route's FIGHT 2 (chieftains_raid, after fight1+sleep have advanced the rng) has the PC drop while Relc survives -- the canonical PC-death-defeat scenario. Separate fixture so its rng can differ from post_tutorial's (which level_up_loop pins to a fight-2 WIN). Issue #45 re-derivation: the old rng_state ('3') was a hand-typed raw RandomNumberGenerator.state, the repo-wide landmine (WISave restores .state directly, not .seed, so a small hand-typed int collapses the first randi() draw to the same degenerate output -- the #38 method). Re-derived via a genuine seed search: for candidate N, seeded a fresh RNG (.seed=N), captured the resulting .state, installed it, and re-ran defeat_ally_alive end-to-end -- seeds 1-5 all changed the outcome (fight 2 now WON, or lost with Relc also down, breaking the exact PC-dies-Relc-lives-at-full-40hp shape this fixture exists to prove); seed=6's derived state (-7039256646584150880) is the first that preserves it exactly, re-verified green.
